family.rule: HOLM inside this family only (v12 family 1 untouched): member p at the SELECTED checkpoint = seed-mean two-sided bootstrap p ((k+1)/(B+1)) of the effect U - R_U of the member statistic (patient-cluster bootstrap recomputed from resampled counts, identical replicates for both arms and all seeds); a member is significant iff its decision-rule outcome is supported (interval excludes 0 in the effect's direction AND every seed has that sign) AND its Holm p < 0.05. The FINAL checkpoint is a consistency check: the same member's seed-mean effect must have the same sign (reported as consistent / inconsistent; it is not a second family). VinDr members are false-claim rates (FPR on images no radiologist marks for the label); CheXpert members are recall and FPR of labels with >= 30 positives; heads with fewer positives are read by mention rate and false-claim rate only
family.mde_rule: planning MDE per member: two-sided alpha 0.05/family size, power 0.8, unpaired normal approximation with planning proportions {'recall': 0.5, 'fpr': 0.05} (conservative: ignores pairing on identical images and seed averaging); computed from reference-label counts only
family.inference_unit: paired patient-cluster bootstrap across arms on identical images, seed-mean effect over seeds 29/43/71 (seed s of U vs seed s of R_U), across-seed SD reported; three seeds carry no between-seed test

extractor.name: CheXbert (Smit et al. 2020) via RadEval F1CheXbert.get_labels(mode='classification')
extractor.independence: CheXbert is not used by the engine (parser/auditor are local LLMs; readers are image classifiers); it never selects data or checkpoints

unknown_handling.reference: benchmark consensus labels are binary; any missing or non-0/1 value fails loudly
unknown_handling.prediction_uncertain: primary: CheXbert uncertain (-1) counts as a positive assertion (hedged mention); strict sensitivity: positives only
unknown_handling.prediction_not_mentioned: negative (a report that omits a finding asserts nothing about it)
unknown_handling.inference_failure: intention to treat: a missing prediction is an empty report (all conditions 0), counted and reported; denominators never shrink
unknown_handling.undefined_metric: precision with no predicted positives, recall with no reference positives, F1 with neither: null, never 0; a macro with any undefined finding is null; undefined bootstrap replicates are counted and excluded from the interval

per_finding: mention_rate (share of generated reports stating the finding at all: raw CheXbert class positive, negative or uncertain for any mapped condition)
per_report: mean_report_words (whitespace tokens of clean_text(prediction); ITT empty = 0)
statistics.overall_and_subsets: each per-finding statistic is macro-averaged over macro_findings ('macro_'), the target findings ('target_') and the non-target findings ('non_target_')
statistics.mention_extraction: raw CheXbert head classes (0 blank, 1 positive, 2 negative, 3 uncertain) from the pinned checkpoint, stored as scores/chexbert_raw4_labels.parquet; they must reproduce the RadEval classification labels exactly (1->1, 3->-1, 0/2->0) or labelling fails
statistics.grounding_reading: Per contrast (arm A vs comparator B; effects A - B), overall (macro), target macro, non-target macro and per macro finding. 'Rises' / 'falls' = the frozen decision-rule outcome supported_increase / supported_decrease (seed-mean patient interval excludes 0 and every seed has that sign). 'Recall does not fall' = NON-INFERIORITY: seed-mean recall interval lower bound >= -0.02 absolute AND no seed's recall change below -0.02. Readings, in order: (0) per finding only: fewer than 30 reference positives or reference negatives on the benchmark -> 'insufficient_support' (statistics still reported); (1) FPR route = recall does not fall AND false-positive rate falls; F1 route = recall does not fall AND F1 rises AND (v8) the false-positive rate does not rise: NON-INFERIORITY, seed-mean FPR interval upper bound <= +0.02 AND no seed's FPR change above +0.02; (2) if only the FPR route holds and the mention rate falls AND recall falls (point change < 0) in every seed -> 'mentions_fewer_findings'; (3) else if either route holds -> 'improved_image_grounded_reporting'; (4) else if the mention rate falls AND recall falls -> 'mentions_fewer_findings'; (5) else 'not_established'.
statistics.per_arm_tables: every statistic above for each of the four matched arms and each seed (score), overall, target and non-target
statistics.macro: unweighted mean of per-finding F1 (and precision, recall) over macro_findings (primary tier, >= 10 reference positives, fixed at freeze from reference labels)
statistics.primary_endpoint: Holm family 1 is EMPTY (v14): derived mechanically from the gated qualification (rule 5.3), no head/view passes all gates at this scale, so no per-finding primary endpoint exists on any benchmark (family_1_v14 gives the per-head reasons). This is a result, not a missing analysis. The confirmatory family is the E2 family (e2_v14); macro-F1 and every other reading are secondary / descriptive
secondary_endpoints: per-finding precision / recall / F1 with support
normal-study false-claim rate (share of reference normal studies with >= 1 positive primary-tier mention, excluding the set's normal_claim_excludes, i.e. labels its normal class admits)
target / non-target macro-F1 (target = frozen corpus operator/finding set via vocabulary_crosswalk)

bootstrap.method: percentile 95% interval; each replicate resamples patients with replacement (swrd.eval.score.cluster_bootstrap_indices draws) and RECOMPUTES TP/FP/FN totals and every metric from them; paired contrasts use identical replicates for both arms and all seeds

seeds.pairing: seed s of arm A with seed s of arm B
seeds.per_seed: effect and paired patient-bootstrap interval for every seed
seeds.seed_mean: mean of per-seed effects; interval from the same patient replicate applied to every seed (uncertainty over test patients conditional on the trained models)
seeds.across_seed: SD (ddof 1), min, max, count of seeds with effect > 0, and t interval with n_seeds - 1 df (training-seed variability)
seeds.never: seed predictions are never concatenated or counted as independent patients

statistics.decision_rule: supported improvement only if the seed-mean patient interval excludes 0 in the favoured direction AND every seed's effect has that sign; otherwise inconclusive. A non-significant difference is not evidence of equivalence.
statistics.multiplicity: one primary contrast (named in the S9 headline protocol before final evaluation); secondary contrasts and endpoints reported with Holm-adjusted p (p = 2 x min one-sided bootstrap tail) where an inferential claim is made

headline_v9.question: image-grounded report label completion (channel/04 latest decision entries; audit docs/reports/consult/20261031T1315_completion_dose_audit.md section D)
headline_v9.primary_endpoints: per-finding positive recall AND F1 on the benchmark labels mapped (primary mapping tier, vocabulary crosswalk) to the completed heads (v9: on test sets DERIVED from the frozen R-all+complete manifest passed as --completion-manifest = heads with >= 1 qualified head/view; every contrast, co-primary and headline file of the family must carry the identical binding). v10: candidates = benchmark labels mapped to the completion-capable non-diagnosis heads ['cardiomegaly', 'pleural_effusion', 'airspace_opacity', 'edema', 'infiltrate', 'consolidation', 'pneumothorax'] (sets.*.primary_endpoint_candidates_v10); an endpoint = a candidate with >= 30 reference positives on that benchmark whose heads include a head qualified in the final manifest. The endpoint set is derived ENTIRELY from the final build (no hand-written list or exclusion). Every endpoint reports the per-view dose of its completed heads (manifest dose_by_head_view) and the benchmark's recorded views that got no completion (e.g. VinDr PA when a head completed on AP only). Both expert benchmarks contribute endpoints. Each endpoint is read with the v8 grounding reading (recall non-inferiority 0.02; F1 route also needs FPR non-inferiority 0.02; fewer-findings guard; 30/30 support gate).
headline_v9.mechanism_check_v11: DESCRIPTIVE, label-free (coordinator decision on head-set audit finding 5a): for every arm on both test sets, the mention rate (stated at all) and positive-claim rate (positive or uncertain) of each sets.*.mechanism_labels_v11 label (the completed heads' labels, e.g. Edema), per seed and seed mean (swrd.eval.external mechanism, --final on test sets; reads no reference label). It answers whether completion changed how often the student claims the completed finding; no inference, never in the Holm family
headline_v9.harm_guard_v11: GUARD (finding 5b): on every test set, each sets.*.harm_guards_v11 label (a completed head's label with 0 test positives; every positive claim is false, so its FPR is the false-claim rate; VinDr Edema for the pinned build) must be FPR NON-INFERIOR for R-all+complete vs R-all+random-additions with the protocol's existing margin (fpr_not_worse: seed-mean interval upper bound <= +0.02 and no seed above +0.02) at BOTH co-primary checkpoints (co-primary field harm_guard_v11.holds). Reported with the headline; a failed guard is reported as edema over-claiming on VinDr against the matched random control and must accompany any headline statement; it does not enter the Holm family
headline_v9.primary_endpoint_caveats: sets.*.primary_endpoint_caveats_v11: pre-declared caveat per endpoint, copied into every contrast / co-primary file (v11; CheXpert test Edema: no view in the prompts, PA-only completion, a null is the expected reading)

view_stratified_reading.declared: v8, before any completion arm trained
view_stratified_reading.rule: every primary endpoint of every contrast is read (1) POOLED over the benchmark - this reading alone enters the endpoint verdict, co-primary rule, Holm family and headline_eligible - and (2) PER VIEW for each view in ['AP', 'PA'] that the benchmark records (sets.*.views): the same statistics and the same v8 grounding reading on that view's images only, with the same patient replicates (bootstrap counts of other-view images are zero). The 30/30 support gate applies per view (sets.*.views.readable). Per-view readings are reported next to the pooled reading and are never a separate headline family, never Holm-adjusted and never change a verdict.
view_stratified_reading.per_benchmark: VinDr test: view source = prompt (PA for all 3,000 images), so the PA reading is identical to the pooled reading by construction; CheXpert test: the benchmark records no view (pooled only); CheXpert val dev: AP/PA from val_labels.csv (pipeline checks)
view_stratified_reading.prompt: the view stays in the prompt for every arm (references, completion, controls, test-time); the comparison is like for like (channel/04 16:33 item 1a)

headline_v9.f1_route_fpr_noninferiority: F1 route = recall non-inferior AND F1 rises AND the endpoint's FPR is non-inferior: seed-mean FPR-change interval upper bound <= +0.02 AND no seed's FPR change above +0.02 (channel/04 16:33 item 1b; review M7)
headline_v9.non_target_guard: non-target macro recall must be non-inferior (seed-mean interval lower bound >= -0.02 and no seed below -0.02); if it is not, every primary endpoint read as improved is reported as 'blocked_non_target_recall_loss'
headline_v9.co_primary_checkpoints: the selected checkpoint (lowest student_validation loss, ties earlier) and the final checkpoint (last update of the declared budget) are co-primary, because real-report validation loss penalises completion arms. An endpoint is 'supported' only if its reading is improved at BOTH checkpoints; improved at one only = 'checkpoint_dependent' (reported, not claimed)
headline_v9.primary_multiplicity: v7 (unchanged in v8): the HEADLINE statement may cite only endpoints with headline_eligible = true (see headline_eligibility_v7); others are reported with unadjusted intervals as per-finding evidence
headline_v9.headline_eligibility_v7: Holm across the whole primary family of the decisive contrast (every primary endpoint on both benchmarks). Endpoint test p at a checkpoint = seed-mean two-sided bootstrap p ((k+1)/(B+1)) of the route that made it improved (F1 route first, else FPR route; 1.0 if no route holds). Endpoint p = max over the selected and final checkpoints (intersection-union, matching the co-primary rule). headline_eligible = co-primary verdict 'supported' AND Holm p < 0.05 (swrd.eval.external headline)
headline_v9.secondary: Holm-adjusted (two-sided seed-mean bootstrap p) across ['macro_f1', 'macro_recall', 'macro_precision', 'macro_fpr', 'macro_mention_rate', 'normal_false_claim_rate', 'mean_report_words', 'strict_sensitivity:macro_f1'] within each contrast, benchmark and checkpoint

model_rules.no_tuning: no mapping, threshold, semantics, checkpoint, decoding or prompt choice may use benchmark outcomes.
